shared_elements: standing human figure, frontal, with legs apart
justification: Both surfaces depict frontal standing human figures with arms held out or up, and both include disc/circular motifs, but that is a near-universal correspondence; A shows stick-thin schematic figures with concentric-circle discs, boats with crew strokes and scattered cupmarks in an open, unframed scatter, while B shows a single dense, elaborately costumed frontal figure with a naturalistic face, headdress and interlocking ornament filling a vertical panel. The manner of depiction is opposite in every respect: extreme linear abstraction and scattered composition versus crowded high-relief detail organised as one axial figure.
